• Type: Rhizomatous
  • Origin: Asia (cultivars arise or are bred in cultivation)
  • Height: 10 - 20+ cm (average height after two months in the tank)

Microsorum pteropus is a highly variable species, and new varieties are easily bred. Microsorum pteropus 'Narrow' has narrower leaves, which grow at a less acute angle from the stem than the normal Microsorum pteropus. Leaves become 10-20 cm and a rhizome from 10-15 cm or more. The plant attaches readily to roots and stones. A decorative plant, which is also suitable for smaller aquariums.
